## findings
1. **SOURCE-TASK RED / SOURCE-CHAIN RED — order-dependent add-on fit (P2(a) + unpinned parallel edges).** Rule: "where at least one offer on the reservation's own project was made within the last twelve whole months, the add-on target yield is the estimated_annual_kwh of the latest of those offers (the one with the latest offer_date) divided by its offered_kw and by estimate_years"; compute `COUNT/LATEST('waitlist_offers', project_id=F('project_id'))` is reservation-scoped (check_compute `eq[holding_pk]=HID`). Second reading, in GT's own order: 1.1 kW at step 23 and 1 217 kWh / 21.18 at step 25 (vs 1.0 / 1 106 / 19.25). Root cause: rule word wider than compute; no rule orders the add-on fit against the standard branch; order_uniqueness asserts independence that the rule text contradicts. Affected: waitlist_ext_addon_request_fit (also standard fit, same words), GT steps 23/25, prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED / SOURCE-POLICY RED — target_yield_source T1 rests on seeded offers the in-force charter forbids (P3, XF-H2).** Overwrite 3 (standard: "no offer is made while its requested kW exceeds the standard usage room of that account"; add-on analog) bars the seeded offers 8d50f1a6 (2026-06-16, Standard, 2.7 requested vs room 2.57 then), 33f77333 (2026-03-10) and ce47a45a (2026-07-21, Add-On, 1.3 vs 1.06 then), and 1340c06d / edc79283 (2024-06-11, 2025-04-08). These are the rows the fits' T1 reads; a history consistent with the charter has none within 12 months → T2 guaranteed per kW 1 053 → standard fit 2.5 kW, add-on fit 1.1 kW (offers 42.28 and 21.18). Affected: initial_state.waitlist_offers, overwrite 3 of both offer policies, computations[0], [2].
3. **SOURCE-CHAIN RED — state-gate sentence admits a reading under which the gate holds at the opening (P5).** "An add-on offer is not made until no Residential Standard reservation queued on the same project remains without an offer." The cottage reservation 5313b50d has four recorded offers (e500f0a5, 1340c06d, edc79283, 8d50f1a6); read as "has had an offer", nothing waits → solution: add-on fit 1.0 → add-on offer 19.25, no standard fit/offer (terminal: cottage queued 2.7 kW, one offer row). The condition "(status offered)" lives only in the prerequisite field. Affected: waitlist_ext_addon_offer_estimate rule; GT steps 18–21.
4. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — sizing adjustments with no stated order (P7).** Multiply-then-replace: standard fit 2.5 / 2.7 / 2.0 kW (2.7 = no change: the standard edge would read as met at opening), add-on fit 0.9 kW, vs 2.2 / 1.0. Affected: both fit rules; GT steps 19, 23.
5. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — add-on fit below the factor floor; F1/F2 on this world.** guaranteed_output_sizing (F1) sizes the fits beyond their own usage room (2.2 kW × 1 170 = 2 574 kWh vs room 2 383 kWh; 1.0 kW → 1 170 vs 1 115); add-on fit keeps 3 surviving factors (< 4). array_wear_allowance (F2): share activation 22 months → 0.995 while Rondout Valley's array is 72 months in service (COD 2020-10-01) → 0.990 (offers 37.02 / 19.15 under the array key). guarantee_output_floor T2 dead (F3). Standard fit, standard offer, add-on offer keep 4 surviving factors each; usage_figure_averaging is mislabelled (F4).
6. Charter-global items with no consequence on this world (cited): P2(b)–(d), P4, P6, T1, O1–O8 (O6: no reconfirmation/position notices seeded for reservations queued since 2023-05-15 and 2025-01-20).
